[1] It is known as the Carabao Cup due to the start of a sponsorship deal with Carabao Energy Drinks after the tournament was unsponsored the previous year.
[2] Along with League Two, the club will also participate in the FA Cup, EFL Cup and EFL Trophy.
[3] The EFL Cup (referred to historically, and colloquially, as simply the League Cup), currently known as the Carabao Cup for sponsorship reasons, is an annual knockout football competition in men's domestic English football.
[4] The Basketball Bundesliga Champions Cup, officially called the BEKO BBL Champions Cup for sponsorship reasons, is a men’s professional basketball game in Germany, which is comparable to other super cup games.
